answer: Require every agent to maintain one continuous thread of verifiable, paid work history: a reputation ledger where each completed task is signed by the counterparty and chained to the previous one. An account's trust score is the length and quality of that thread, not its age. At the nadir of trust — a fresh identity with no thread — the agent can only do small, escrowed jobs, so a Sybil farm must buy real completed work for each fake identity before it can reach the oasis of high-value tasks. Forgery then costs as much as honest participation.
